race.comment: ST GOTTHARD (7) highly rated colt resuming. Thrown in the deep end at his second race start with a breathtaking 4-len win over 1200m at the Gold Coast in the G3 Ken Russell last May. No excuses from the draw and can remain undefeated. WARWOVEN (5) fast colt plagued by wide gates at his last two outings. Snagged back to last first up before carving out good closing splits when fifth in the G3 San Domenico Stakes over 1100m at this track. Expecting a more positive ride today. Respect. PLAGIARISM (8) took control early with a slick win in the G3 Up and Coming Stakes at this track over 1300m. Sure to give a ton of cheek again. CENTRAL EUROPE (11) placed at all three starts in stakes grade and will keep improving as he gets out in trip this time in. Closed well first up when third in the LR The Rosebud over 1100m here. Desperate for the fast tempo and gets the services of the in-form Zac Lloyd. BERZELIUS (3) is going better than his price suggests
